name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=chapter_intro_dialog, descriptor=subframe_anim_counter, which correctly reflects both role (sub-frame animation/blink phase counter) and data type (scalar counter). No Ghidra address residue (the trailing 'counter' is a descriptor, not a hex address); no spurious domain ID. Accurate as-is.
purpose: Sub-frame animation/blink phase counter for the chapter-intro dialog panels; selects the portrait animation phase shown by the dialog and party-roster/promote grid renderers.
logic_summary: Driven exclusively by fd2_render_chapter_intro_dialog_panels @0x2D9FE (called per BIOS-tick): incremented (INC dword [0x54153]) only when the master frame_idx @0x54133 is odd, and unconditionally reset to 0 when it reaches 4 (CMP ==4 then MOV 0, every call) -> cycles 0->1->2->3->0. Read as the blink/animation phase by that same renderer (mode 2 anim_phase) and by fd2_render_party_roster_grid, fd2_render_party_roster_with_item_stat_preview, fd2_render_promote_members_grid, fd2_render_promote_candidates_grid; every reader applies the same map of value 3->1 (phases 0,1,2,3 -> 0,1,2,1).
datatype: undefined4 (uint32 in src) -- single 4-byte scalar; disasm confirms dword-only access (INC/CMP/MOV dword ptr [0x54153]), not an array
element_semantics: Scalar sub-frame index, value 0..3; readers collapse 3->1 to yield 3 distinct portrait animation phases (0,1,2).
notes: BSS global in .object2 (reads zeros = zero-init at link, not const). Ghidra PLATE_COMMENT was empty (<none>) so a concise src-derived data plate was created via run_script_inline cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...). src comment block at rndmenu.c:1108-1112 already accurate/concise/ASCII -> kept (no Edit, so no src diff). NOTE (out of scope, not this symbol): rndmenu.c lines 36-38 flag a suspected name-inversion on two OTHER globals data_fd2_chapter_intro_portrait_pose_x_column_table / _y_row_table -- left untouched per single-symbol rule.
